prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Setting Up Your Desktop Pet", "Try moving and interacting with your companion's desktop preview widget while we finish initial pet asset setup.", "Click and drag to position your desktop pet anywhere on screen."]
1: ["Choose Your Companion Style"]
2: ["Save Your Pet to Account", "Sign in to securely link your newly adopted companion across all your devices."]
3: ["Discover Companion Behaviors", "Each path brings unique desktop reactions, animations, and assistance styles.", "Choose My Path"]
4: ["Tip: Use well-lit photos with simple backgrounds for optimal custom pet rendering accuracy."]
5: ["Your Companion is Ready on Your Desktop!", "Press Alt+Pet (or double click the system tray icon) anytime to summon, hide, or speak with your new pet."]
6: []
7: ["Signing in ensures your desktop pet data is backed up and easily restored if reinstalled."]
8: ["Initializing Desktop Engine", "We are preparing your companion's high-resolution desktop animations and background tray services."]
9: ["Seal Your Companion's Adoption Certificate", "Confirm & Meet Pet"]
